## Checklist

- [ ] `just check` passes (lint, format, shim audit, 100% coverage, integration)
- [ ] New Sources files are classified (logic-manifest.txt or declaredExclusions, with a reason)
- [ ] New behavior has a Gherkin scenario mapped to an XCTest (+ traceability.md row)
- [ ] Architecture decisions are recorded as an ADR (or none were made)
- [ ] `just smoke` run for changes to the composition root, URL handling, or watcher
